3.1.6.2.3 Port Interface
The Temperature_C is used to define the SenderReceiverInterface which is
used to type the "transport" of a temperature in degree Celsius between SwCompo-
nentTypes. Please note that in the show case, this PortInterface is not only used
to type the "transport" of TPlant, but also to type the "transport" of TEnv.
